svg.title: Leader Election
svg.desc: Leader Election. Instances elect one coordinator; another takes over when its lease expires. Step 1, All three run it, or none: Uncoordinated, all three start the billing run; pin it to one and nothing runs when that one dies. Step 2, Win the lease: Each tries a compare-and-set on the lease. A wins it with token 33 and renews it every 5 s. Step 3, Leader fails, B takes over: A stops renewing. 15 s after its last renewal the lease expires, and B takes it with token 34. Step 4, Old leader returns: fenced: A was only paused. It wakes and writes with token 33, but the database has seen 34 and rejects it.

g.text: 1 · All three run it, or none
1 · All three run it, or none
Uncoordinated, all three start the billing run; pin it to one and nothing runs when that one dies.
Each tries a compare-and-set on the lease. A wins it with token 33 and renews it every 5 s.
A stops renewing. 15 s after its last renewal the lease expires, and B takes it with token 34.
A was only paused. It wakes and writes with token 33, but the database has seen 34 and rejects it.
e.g. a Kubernetes Lease or etcd
expires 15 s after the last renewal
taken only if it is free or expired,
the only one with the job
checks the token on every write
rejects a write with a lower token
A alone had it and died: no run
no lease yet: nothing coordinates the instances
no work until the lease expires
